title: Rules rendered from a linked worktree write that…
what: lib/relay_rules.py:37: MEDIUM: F2 rules rendered from a linked worktree write that worktree's rule paths into the global CLAUDE.md (install passes wait=False)
why: Found 26 Oct by the review of wt/setup-wt-market (outside that change). Checked the same day: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md names no worktree path, so no damage yet; it would happen on the next install run from a linked worktree.
failing_case: install() run from /Users/amidman/relay/.worktrees/x calls relay_rules.sync(..., only={"global",...}, wait=False); rules() builds each
"Full text: `<path>`" from os.path.join(ROOT, "rules", name), so ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md lists /Users/amidman/relay/.worktrees/x/rules/openspec.md,
which is gone after the merge. It should list /Users/amidman/relay/rules/openspec.md.
pass_cases: 1. ROOT = linked worktree of a temp relay copy, temp CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, sync of the global target: every "Full text:" path starts with the main checkout.
2. ROOT = the main checkout: paths unchanged from today.
3. The rule text itself (title, gist) still comes from the checkout being rendered.
